meta.name: ray-data
meta.description: Scalable data processing for ML workloads. Streaming execution across CPU/GPU, supports Parquet/CSV/JSON/images. Integrates with Ray Train, PyTorch, TensorFlow. Scales from single machine to 100s of nodes. Use for batch inference, data preprocessing, multi-modal data loading, or distributed ETL pipelines.

copy.tagline: 用分布式引擎处理机器学习数据流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多节点上高效处理大规模ML数据
copy.tagline_en: Process machine learning data pipelines with distributed engine
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to efficiently process large-scale ML data across multiple nodes

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以用 Ray Data 处理大规模数据集（>100GB），支持分布式数据预处理、批量推理和多模态数据加载，并能与 PyTorch、TensorFlow 等框架集成。
howto.when: 当你需要处理超过 100GB 的数据集、进行分布式数据预处理、构建批量推理管道或加载多模态数据（如图像、音频）时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Ray Data to process large datasets (>100GB), perform distributed data preprocessing, batch inference, and multi-modal data loading, integrating with PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to process datasets larger than 100GB, perform distributed data preprocessing, build batch inference pipelines, or load multi-modal data (e.g., images, audio).
